about: Built, not shipped. Daemons v0.10.0 to v0.12.0 stamped a record's start and end from two wall-clock
readings, so a clock step between them could write a genuine record that ends before it starts
(5d6270398, 2026-10-01, measured one 1.3 s early and made the end the start plus monotonic elapsed
time). Each record below is a release's own vector (the version 1 record v0.11.1 signed, as
golden.json copies it, and v0.22.0's version 2 record) with endedUnixMs set 1300 ms before
startedUnixMs, its digest computed by record/testdata/record_v5.py's digest. Reading such a record
was retired by the decision of 2026-11-21 (docs/run-records.md): every reader refuses both,
with the retirement's text (record.RetiredEndBeforeStartText), not the text a current record's
refusal gives. record_v5.py copies them into golden.json's refused records. Never edited.

records.name: a version 1 record that ends 1.3 s before it starts
a version 2 record that ends 1.3 s before it starts
